name: The Red Dowry
source: Your tiny, secluded and humble village has followed the tradition of marrying a girl to a secluded village on the mountains near you for ninety-years, with the special rule that no individual from your village ever goes to that village, and that the girl fully commits to her new life. On the hundredth occasion of this tradition, your own wedding, you find out exactly why.
translation: 你们这个小而僻静的村庄九十年来一直遵循着将女孩嫁给你们附近山上一个僻静村庄的传统，有一个特殊的规定，即你们村里的任何人都不能去那个村庄，并且女孩必须完全致力于她的新生活。在这一传统的第一百次，也就是你自己的婚礼上，你就会明白其中的原因。
